lorenzo: Quick triage note — magnet20k-int4 onboarding hit a KV-cache index reset during a ~30k-token summarization run. Minimal repro below.

ciara: Paste repro?

lorenzo: Run: `./run_eval --model magnet20k-int4 --prompt-file tests/long_summaries.txt --stream --kv-mode=shared`
Log snippet: `... kv_index=28464 -> kv_index=1  // sudden wrap at step 278`

ajay: Sounds like compaction/rebase while prefill in flight. Which rotary path?

lorenzo: rotary_v2 (fused) + sparse-windowing. Only on int4. FP16 clean.

sam: Any infra events?

lorenzo: KV pager logged `rebase_base new_base=1 old_base=28000` a few ms before.

ciara: If compaction races with inflight prefill, indices can be computed against stale base.

ajay: Hypotheses: (1) compaction without synchronizing kernel view, (2) quant kernel caching kv_base non-atomically.

lorenzo: I reran with `--kv-disable-compaction` and with `--kv-stable-pin`. Both eliminated the repro.

ciara: Good repro. Plan: add CI fuzz to force timing interleaving, and guard quant kernels to read kv_base atomically and fall back when mismatch.

ajay: I'll draft a patch to atomically snapshot kv_base at kernel entry and assert on unexpected wrap; fallback to safe scalar indexing on mismatch.

sam: I'll add eng-ml/kv-compaction-race-fuzz job and a `--kv-dump-on-assert` helper for artifacts.

lorenzo: Added a small harness for the CI test that does a slow prefill + concurrent stream to increase race likelihood. Uploaded a sample dump to the onboarding ticket: https://redwood-internal/issue/ML-ONB-4821#artifact

ajay: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8342 — atomic read + fallback + test.

ciara: Reviewing. If green, merge to staging and run the fuzz job 24h. Action items: ajay (PR EOD), sam (CI job tomorrow), lorenzo (harness + uploads). qa-bot: scheduled eng-ml/kv-compaction-race-fuzz at 1764444480.

lorenzo: Thanks team — demoted blocked->in-progress. :thumbsup:
